metadata.summary: The Tabula Sapiens is a molecular atlas integrating single-cell transcriptomic data from 483,152 cells across 24 tissues and 15 donors, using a unified processing pipeline. It provides cell-type annotations spanning many human organs and serves as a reference for tissue mapping, cell-type identification, and cross-tissue comparative studies.
metadata.purpose: To serve as a reference for tissue mapping, cell-type identification, and cross-tissue comparative studies.

papers.title: The Tabula Sapiens: A molecular atlas of diverse cell types across the human body

ethics.privacy_measures: De-identified donor data; no protected health information retained.

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.
pending_verification: The following LLM fields were auto-dropped for violating schema constraints and reverted to baseline; pending manual review: medical_fields[list-items]

known_limitations: Limited to 15 donors and 24 tissues; underrepresentation of rare cell types; absence of longitudinal sampling; potential batch effects despite unified pipeline.
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Data processed through unified computational pipeline (normalization, integration, clustering); no synthetic data generation reported.
bias_sources: sampling_bias (limited donor count and tissue coverage)
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: 15 donors may not represent global demographic diversity; ethnicity not reported.
bias_and_limitations.long_tail_classes: Rare cell types underrepresented due to sampling depth and detection limits.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Findings generalizable to healthy adult human tissues represented; limited generalizability to disease states, pediatric/elderly populations, or underrepresented ethnic groups.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: Gender-balanced; age mean 51 years; ethnicity and geographic origin not reported.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Ethnicity, detailed clinical metadata, and socioeconomic variables not reported.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Donors selected to represent diverse tissues and balanced gender; age range not specified in abstract but mean age stated as 51 in descriptor.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Single-cell RNA-seq from 24 tissues across 15 donors; unified processing pipeline applied.
data_origin.aggregation_multisource: Multi-institution consortium; no description of aggregation method or impact on composition in source text.

population.target_population: Human donors providing tissue samples for single-cell RNA-seq

annotation.annotation_method: Cell-type annotations generated by expert curation with cross-tissue consistency checks.
annotation.labeling_provenance: Manually curated cell-type labels based on marker gene expression and literature.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Clinical diagnosis or therapeutic decision support without further validation.
